headline: DMV Fantasy: Preseason Front Office Brief
executive_summary: DMV Fantasy is projected #10 of 16 with a 587.60 projected-starting-lineup C-AVI total, led by Jayden Daniels, Breece Hall, and George Kittle. The immediate priority is improving the FLEX slot without weakening that core.

projected_power.method: Sum of the eight verified projected starters' C-AVI values from all 16 AVI-Core team files

dynasty_power.method: Sum of every verified rostered player's D-AVI value from all 16 AVI-Core team files

latest_trade.summary: On July 24, DMV Fantasy traded with Big Balder Brand and acquired Breece Hall while sending Cam Little, Saquon Barkley. Breece Hall is now the current RB starter at 88.2 C-AVI and 92.9 D-AVI.

gap_closing_moves: Raise the FLEX slot above Rachaad White's 57.4 C-AVI baseline; a replacement near 88.2 C-AVI would directly attack the 30.80-point projected gap to Badland Banditos.
